blocks.text: PORTLAND, Oregon — Deni Avdija had 26 points and eight rebounds, Toumani Camara added 20 points and eight rebounds and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Golden State Warriors 116-94 on Friday night to advance to the NBA Cup quarterfinals. Portland led by 36 points in the first half and Golden State cut it to 10 in the fourth quarter before Portland regained control. With its margin of victory and San Antonio’s win over the Lakers, Portland will host the Memphis Grizzlies on Dec. 5. Scoot Henderson added 18 points for Portland off the bench.
